verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a game engine could plausibly offer an isolated test environment. But the evidence pack never documents a sandbox that is isolated from production data. Play-in-editor testing (unreal-docs-9), the Automation Test Framework and Gauntlet test sessions are testing features, not documented isolation from live or production data, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
